detached_structure.evidence: A small greenish-roofed shed-like structure sits in the lawn at the lower left of the house inside the outline; it is small and partly shaded.

signals.notes: Lot is a long narrow parcel with the house near the front, a large open back lawn, and dark ornamental trees shading the front and side; the paved driveway and gray-roofed garage to the left appear to fall outside the outline, on the neighboring lot.
